note: Native input context per system on the common protocol (manuscript section 4.1). Score integration is identical for every system: mean of 5 s segment margins over 1 / 2 / 4 consecutive segments (5 / 10 / 20 s; 20 s primary), aln42.external_eval.integrate. EEG spans are within one trial; no system sees EEG beyond its trial.

proposed_temporal_CS.native_unit: 3 crops x 0.40 s around each of 16 anchors per 5 s segment (offsets -0.20..+0.60 s)

mtrf.native_unit: backward lags 0..500 ms per reconstructed sample

vlaai.native_unit: 5 s window (released training window), whole segment

transformer_clip.native_unit: 3 s encoder window; windows at +0/+1/+2 s overlap-added

mindmix_complete.native_unit: 2 s window (EEG + candidate audio); sub-windows at +0/+1.5/+3.0 s

context_matched_sensitivity: match the actual EEG span contributing to a decision (e.g. restrict every system to the proposed system 0.203-4.75 s span per segment, or extend the proposed system to the full 5 s); not executed here
